<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>CPU Temperature — 7 Day Chart</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0d1117;
    --panel: #161b22;
    --ink: #e6edf3;
    --muted: #8b949e;
    --grid: #21262d;
    --axis: #6e7681;
    --line: #ff7b54;
    --fill: rgba(255, 123, 84, 0.18);
    --hot: #ff5c5c;
    --cold: #4cc2ff;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 24px;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  header { text-align: center; }
  h1 {
    margin: 0 0 4px;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 650;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  }
  .sub {
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .card {
    background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 20px 22px 26px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    background: #0b0f14;
    border-radius: 10px;
    width: 1080px;
    height: 540px;
  }
  .legend {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  .sw { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block; }
  .sw.line { background: var(--line); }
  .sw.hot { background: var(--hot); }
  .sw.cold { background: var(--cold); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <header>
    <h1>CPU Temperature — Last 7 Days</h1>
    <div class="sub">Daily peak readings (°C), 40–85 °C range</div>
  </header>

  <div class="card">
    <canvas id="chart" width="1080" height="540" aria-label="Line chart of CPU temperature over seven days"></canvas>
  </div>

  <div class="legend">
    <span><i class="sw line"></i> Temperature (°C)</span>
    <span><i class="sw hot"></i> Thermal ceiling (85 °C)</span>
    <span><i class="sw cold"></i> Cool floor (40 °C)</span>
  </div>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('chart');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // Seven days of CPU temperature readings (peak °C), all within 40–85.
  const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
  const temps = [52, 61, 58, 67, 74, 70, 63];

  const TEMP_MIN = 40;
  const TEMP_MAX = 85;

  // High-DPI scaling so it stays crisp on a 1280x800 screen.
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const cssW = 1080, cssH = 540;
  canvas.width = cssW * dpr;
  canvas.height = cssH * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

  // Plot margins (in CSS pixels).
  const M = { top: 40, right: 40, bottom: 64, left: 72 };
  const plotW = cssW - M.left - M.right;
  const plotH = cssH - M.top - M.bottom;

  const xFor = i => M.left + (plotW * i) / (days.length - 1);
  const yFor = t => M.top + plotH - (plotH * (t - TEMP_MIN)) / (TEMP_MAX - TEMP_MIN);

  // --- Gridlines + Y axis labels (every 5 °C) ---------------------------
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.font = '13px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  for (let t = TEMP_MIN; t <= TEMP_MAX; t += 5) {
    const y = yFor(t);

    // Gridline.
    ctx.strokeStyle = (t === TEMP_MIN || t === TEMP_MAX) ? '#3a4250' : 'var(--grid)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = (t === TEMP_MIN || t === TEMP_MAX) ? '#3a4250' : '#21262d';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(M.left, y);
    ctx.lineTo(M.left + plotW, y);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Y tick label.
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8b949e';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(t + '°', M.left - 12, y);
  }

  // --- X axis labels (day names) -----------------------------------------
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c9d1d9';
  ctx.font = '14px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
  days.forEach((d, i) => {
    ctx.fillText(d, xFor(i), M.top + plotH + 14);
  });

  // --- Axis lines -------------------------------------------------------
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#6e7681';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(M.left, M.top);
  ctx.lineTo(M.left, M.top + plotH);          // Y axis
  ctx.lineTo(M.left + plotW, M.top + plotH);  // X axis
  ctx.stroke();

  // --- Axis titles ------------------------------------------------------
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8b949e';
  ctx.font = '13px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';

  // Y axis title (rotated).
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(22, M.top + plotH / 2);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('Temperature (°C)', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();

  // X axis title.
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText('Day of week', M.left + plotW / 2, cssH - 18);

  // --- Area fill under the line -----------------------------------------
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(xFor(0), yFor(temps[0]));
  for (let i = 1; i < temps.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(xFor(i), yFor(temps[i]));
  ctx.lineTo(xFor(temps.length - 1), M.top + plotH);
  ctx.lineTo(xFor(0), M.top + plotH);
  ctx.closePath();
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, M.top, 0, M.top + plotH);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 123, 84, 0.28)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 123, 84, 0.02)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fill();

  // --- The temperature line ---------------------------------------------
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff7b54';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(xFor(0), yFor(temps[0]));
  for (let i = 1; i < temps.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(xFor(i), yFor(temps[i]));
  ctx.stroke();

  // --- Data points + value labels ---------------------------------------
  temps.forEach((t, i) => {
    const x = xFor(i), y = yFor(t);

    // Halo.
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0f14';
    ctx.fill();

    // Dot.
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7b54';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0b0f14';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Value label above the point.
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e6edf3';
    ctx.font = '600 14px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
    ctx.fillText(t + '°', x, y - 12);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
